name: Mukesh Ambani

lifetimeGiving.source: No personal lifetime giving figure found. Reliance Foundation is funded by Reliance Industries Ltd's statutory CSR spend (Companies Act 2013 2% rule), not personal wealth: INR 2,156 crore in FY2024-25 (RIL integrated annual report).

foundation.name: Reliance Foundation (chaired by Nita Ambani; CSR arm of Reliance Industries Ltd)
foundation.relatedPartyFinding: Foundation is funded by and reports through the listed company (RIL) rather than by the family personally; spend is statutory corporate CSR.

onTheRecord.finding: RIL Integrated Annual Report 2024-25: 'In FY 2024-25, Reliance Industries Limited spent INR 2,156 Crore towards CSR' (approx. 21.56 billion INR); Reliance Foundation claims 8.6 crore lives impacted since 2010. Prior year FY2023-24: INR 1,592 crore (press).

Electoral bonds disclosure (Mar 2024): Qwik Supply Chain Pvt Ltd, the third-largest bond buyer at INR 410 crore (2021-22 to 2023-24; INR 385 cr to BJP, INR 25 cr to Shiv Sena), was reported by Reuters and The Reporters' Collective to be affiliated with Reliance via directors/addresses; RIL stated Qwik 'is not a subsidiary of any Reliance entity'.

notes: Forbes real-time 9/27/26: $84B; citizenship India; source of wealth 'Diversified'; no Forbes philanthropy score visible on the profile page. latestGrantsMillions is in INR millions (2,156 crore = 21,560 million INR) for fiscal year ending 31 Mar 2025, taken from RIL's annual report page (primary). Reliance Foundation publishes its own annual reports at reliancefoundation.org but no separate endowment/asset figure was seen. Not a Giving Pledge signatory as far as seen; full-list check not performed within budget. Political 2024 figure left null: the INR 410 crore is via a company whose Reliance link RIL denies, so recorded as on-the-record only.
